summary: Frontend-only regression for Dina Perles hero + artisane ordering fixes. All 7 checks pass: (1) /artisane mobile 390px shows artisan-cutout img above h1 (img.y=100 < h1.y=568); (2) /artisane desktop 1920px shows h1 above img (h1.y=172 < img.y=719); (3) home 1920x900 hero-mini-cards contains exactly 2 cards and both cards.x >= img.x+img.width-20 (threshold=1296.83, cards at 1499/1683); (4) home 390px hero-mini-cards-mobile visible with 3 cards; (5) no overlap between hero-cta-explore-button and cutout image on mobile; (6) hero-add-to-cart-button opens cart-drawer with product added; (7) zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroEditorial.js uses hidden lg:flex for desktop mini-cards but the min-h and h-[calc(100svh-110px)] may cause tight fit at 1920x900 — currently fine (bottom-8 + card ~232px stays within container).
ArtisanHero uses flex-col-reverse lg:flex-col which correctly inverts mobile ordering; consistent pattern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes are verified working. Backend not tested per request. Hero cutout image right position at lg uses right-[31%] so cards at right-8/lg:right-12 sit clearly to the right of the image.
